headlines.name: Math115.WeightedExit.weighted_retry_mass
headlines.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} {D : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype D] [inst_2 : DecidableEq D]
  (q : OAI.ContingencyTables.ResidualMixture.RationalLaw X) (trial : X → Option D)
  (target : OAI.ContingencyTables.ResidualMixture.RationalLaw D) (a : ℚ),
  (∀ (d : D), OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.successMass q trial d = a * target.mass d) →
    ∀ (fallback d : D) (J : ℕ),
      (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.retryLaw q trial fallback J).mass d =
        (1 - (1 - a) ^ J) * target.mass d + if d = fallback then (1 - a) ^ J else 0

headlines.name: Math115.WeightedExit.star_retry_mass
headlines.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} {D : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype D] [inst_2 : DecidableEq D]
  (q : OAI.ContingencyTables.ResidualMixture.RationalLaw X) (trial : X → Option D) (S : D → ℚ),
  (∀ (d : D), 0 ≤ S d) →
    0 < ∑ d, S d →
      ∀ (ρ w : ℚ),
        0 < w →
          (∀ (d : D), OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.successMass q trial d = ρ * S d / w) →
            ∀ (fallback d : D) (J : ℕ),
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.retryLaw q trial fallback J).mass d =
                (1 - (1 - (ρ * ∑ e, S e) / w) ^ J) * (S d / ∑ e, S e) +
                  if d = fallback then (1 - (ρ * ∑ e, S e) / w) ^ J else 0

headlines.name: Math115.WeightedExit.flat_star_retry_variation
headlines.statement:
∀ {X : Type u_1} {D : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype D] [inst_2 : DecidableEq D]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq X] {k : ℕ} (draw : (Fin k → Bool) → X) (trial : X → Option D)
  (q : OAI.ContingencyTables.ResidualMixture.RationalLaw X) (S : D → ℚ) (hS : ∀ (d : D), 0 ≤ S d) (hpos : 0 < ∑ d, S d)
  (ρ w : ℚ),
  0 < w →
    (∀ (d : D), OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.successMass q trial d = ρ * S d / w) →
      ∀ (fallback : D) (J : ℕ) (δ : ℚ),
        OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw draw) q ≤
            δ →
          OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
                (Math115.CompletionBooleanRetry.flatRetry (fun word => trial (draw word)) fallback J))
              (Math115.WeightedExit.starLaw S hS hpos) ≤
            (1 - (ρ * ∑ e, S e) / w) ^ J + ↑J * δ
